about: Established in 1994, Crystal Crop Protection Limited is an Indian crop solutions company engaged in the research, development, manufacturing, and distribution of crop protection products and seeds. Its diversified portfolio includes herbicides, fungicides, insecticides, natural crop solutions, and hybrid seeds for field and vegetable crops. The company operates manufacturing and seed processing units across Haryana, Gujarat, Jammu & Kashmir, Maharashtra, Telangana, and Karnataka, supported by a pan-India distribution network.

objects.purpose: Repayment/pre-payment, in full or part, of certain borrowings availed by the Company
Investment in Material Subsidiary Saffire Crop Science Private Limited for repayment/pre-payment of borrowings
Funding inorganic growth through unidentified acquisitions and strategic initiatives and general corporate purposes

promoters.background: Nand Kishore Aggarwal is the Founder and Chairman Emeritus with over three decades in the agri-input sector. Ankur Aggarwal is Chairman and Managing Director, leading business strategy and operations since 2006.

concentration.note: The company generally enters into short-term non-exclusive supply agreements via purchase orders without volume commitments.

litigation_note: Total outstanding legal proceedings against the Company, Subsidiaries, Promoters, Directors, KMPs and SMPs amount to ₹341.95 crore (16.76% of net worth as of June 30, 2026), including DGFT proceedings involving ₹75.53 crore.
strengths: Integrated crop solutions model offering agrochemical formulations, technicals, and seed products with backward integration.
Strong in-house R&D infrastructure with GLP-approved research center and extensive field research stations across India.
Pan-India distribution network comprising 14,717 active distributors and 34 distribution centers across 23 states.
Proven track record of inorganic growth and integrating marquee brands like Bavistin, Tilt, and Gramoxone.
Multi-generational promoter leadership with substantial agricultural industry expertise.

risks.title: Criminal and regulatory proceedings under Foreign Trade Policy
risks.detail: Company and Promoters face proceedings for alleged violations of DGFT Handbook of Procedures involving ₹75.53 crore, representing 3.47% of net worth.

risks.title: Substantial outstanding litigation
risks.detail: Pending legal proceedings against Company, Subsidiaries, Promoters, and Directors amount to ₹341.95 crore, which is 16.76% of net worth as of June 30, 2026.

risks.title: High dependence on Indian domestic market
risks.detail: Revenue is predominantly derived from domestic sales, making performance vulnerable to cyclicality and downturns in the Indian agricultural sector.

risks.title: Vulnerability to climatic conditions and seasonality
risks.detail: Business is seasonal and heavily exposed to weather fluctuations, erratic rainfall, pest outbreaks, and shifts in cropping patterns.

risks.title: Absence of long-term customer contracts
risks.detail: Most sales to distributors and clients are based on short-term purchase orders with no long-term volume commitments.

risks.title: Lengthy product development and regulatory cycles
risks.detail: Commercializing new agrochemicals and seeds takes 5 to 7 years, subject to stringent statutory clearances and risk of competitor preemption.

risks.title: Related party transactions
risks.detail: The company has engaged in multiple related-party transactions and may continue to do so, posing potential conflict of interest risks.

risks.title: Unavailability of historical secretarial records
risks.detail: Independent search confirmed the untraceability of several corporate records and RoC filings dating between 1995 and 2011.

notes: Financial figures are restated consolidated. Stub period of three months ended June 30, 2026 is excluded from annual arrays. Pre-IPO placement of ₹84.29 crore was completed at ₹272.07 per share, reducing the fresh issue size to ₹355.00 crore.
